title: Multi-Sector Booking Platform
description: This custom offer covers Phase 1 of the project, focused on building the complete system foundation, scalable backend architecture, booking workflow, and professional UI/UX design for a multi-sector booking platform. The platform supports industries such as Beauty, Fitness, and Wellness through a modular and scalable architecture. The project includes responsive dashboard design, business onboarding workflows, booking management, staff management, notification systems, and secure role-based access control. The system is developed with future scalability in mind, including a payment-ready structure for subscriptions and commissions.
features: Professional UI/UX design for Admin, Business, Staff, and Client dashboards
Fully responsive design for mobile, tablet, and desktop
Modular multi-sector architecture for Beauty, Fitness, and Wellness
Business onboarding and admin verification workflow
Service management with custom durations and dynamic pricing
Staff management and service assignment system
Real-time booking calendar and availability management
Secure role-based authentication and access control
Scalable REST API and database architecture
Payment-ready backend structure for subscriptions and commissions

title: HierroMarket Custom eCommerce Platform
description: HierroMarket is a modern eCommerce platform for the online sale of iron and steel products including sheets, bars, tubes, profiles, plates, and coils, along with industrial services such as cut-to-size and bending. The platform is designed for both B2C and scalable B2B operations with a modern industrial UI, configurable product options, advanced pricing logic, and SEO optimization.
features: Conversion-focused homepage with trust sections and CTAs
Dynamic pricing engine using Excel-based formulas
Automated shipping logic based on weight and size
Guest checkout and multiple payment methods

title: Board Games E-Commerce Website & Dynamic QR Code Integration
description: A modern and scalable e-commerce platform for board games and merchandise featuring dynamic QR code integration for product tracking and marketing. The platform is designed to support future expansion with secure payment systems, SEO optimization, CMS pages, and a mobile-first responsive experience.
features: Product catalog with expandable product categories
Dynamic QR code generation and management
QR codes with editable destination URLs

title: Live Event Audience Interaction Platform
description: A live event interaction platform that enables parents and audiences to submit real-time quotes, reactions, and photos through QR code access. Approved submissions are displayed dynamically on large event screens, creating an interactive and family-friendly audience experience.
features: Dynamic live feed display on large screens

title: B2B2C Fundraising Platform
description: A scalable B2B2C fundraising platform designed for organizations to manage fundraising campaigns with integrated e-commerce functionality. The platform includes customer storefronts, organization dashboards, and internal admin systems with secure payment integrations and campaign management tools.
features: Internal admin dashboard with CRUD management
Scalable API integrations and backend architecture

title: Open Water Diver Booking Platform
description: A scuba diving course booking and management platform featuring secure payments, scheduling, messaging, analytics, e-commerce integration, and online waiver management. The system is designed for both customers and administrators with responsive dashboards and automation tools.
features: User account creation and profile management
Online waiver and form submission system

title: Walkthroughz Interactive Platform
description: An interactive digital platform focused on immersive walkthrough experiences with a modern responsive design and scalable architecture for future enhancements and integrations.
